title: Neon Light
body:
"Fill it up to make it emit the color of the material!"

Description

Neon Light is a one-time use schematic purchasable at Illumine Designs for $900.

When placed on the property, it takes appearance of a unique smooth cylinder schematic

Similar to the Fire Emitter, The Neon Light can be filled with any material, which will affect the color of neon glow.
